emissions.note: editable parameters and their provenance are frozen inside the instances (drivers' vehicle and vehicles.default); figures are recomputed from validated decisions

environment_requirements.note: methods are resolved from trusted local installations by id, version and code hash; the bundle contains no executable code

detour_s.definition: sum of the drivers' detour times of the validated matches

served.definition: number of riders with a validated match

evaluation.ranking: lexicographic: max served, then min detour_s

timing.solver_time: solver-reported time; method wall time when no solver
timing.total_time: platform wall time of the isolated execution

metrics.definition: number of riders with a validated match
metrics.label: Served riders

metrics.definition: sum of the drivers' detour times of the validated matches
metrics.label: Total detour

fuel_consumption_l_100km.applicability: EU, new petrol passenger cars registered in 2021
fuel_consumption_l_100km.notes: Real-world (on-board fuel consumption meter) value; the WLTP type-approval value in the same table is 6.38 L/100 km. The report notes the sample is about 7 % heavier than the fleet.
fuel_consumption_l_100km.source: European Commission, COM(2024) 122 final, report on real-world CO2 emissions and fuel consumption of cars and vans (OBFCM), Table 3: average real-world fuel consumption of petrol cars

fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.applicability: UK forecourt petrol blend; combustion only (tank-to-wheel), well-to-tank excluded
fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.notes: CO2e with AR5 global-warming potentials; the CO2-only component is 2.06107 kg/L. 100 % mineral petrol: 2.35372 kg CO2e/L.
fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026, Scope 1 fuels, Petrol (average biofuel blend), kg CO2e per litre = 2.07500

provenance.notes: Platform preset: consumption from an EU regulatory report, fuel factor from the UK government conversion factors. Override any value with your own documented figure.

electricity_consumption_kwh_100km.notes: No official EU average electricity consumption of battery-electric cars was found; the value only illustrates the computation.
electricity_consumption_kwh_100km.source: demonstration assumption — not a measured or published value; edit before any study

electricity_emission_factor_g_per_kwh.applicability: France, public electricity generation (generation-based; no import/export adjustment; direct emissions, not life-cycle)
electricity_emission_factor_g_per_kwh.notes: 2023: 48 g CO2e/kWh; 2022: 71 g CO2e/kWh (same data file).
electricity_emission_factor_g_per_kwh.source: European Environment Agency, indicator ENER038 'Greenhouse gas emission intensity of electricity generation', data file FIG2-291456-ENER038, row France, year 2024 (EEA early estimate)

provenance.notes: Demonstration vehicle: the consumption is an assumption, the grid factor is the EEA figure of the France preset (see the parameter's source).
